categories.main_business_segments: Hyungji Elite Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three business segments: student uniforms (school uniforms), B2B uniforms and fashion apparel, and sports merchandising. The student uniform segment focuses on manufacturing and selling school uniforms and related products. The B2B segment supplies corporate uniforms and workwear to various industries. The sports merchandising segment involves licensing and selling sports team and athlete-related apparel and merchandise.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs a multi-variety small-lot production system tailored to individual school designs, utilizing outsourced sewing factories and a structured production planning system. It emphasizes functional and high-quality materials, including eco-friendly recycled fabrics made from PET bottles. Production involves stages of cutting, sewing, and finishing, with quality control and technical guidance provided to partner suppliers. The company also integrates quick response manufacturing to meet seasonal demand peaks.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include schools nationwide for student uniforms, corporate clients across industries such as shipbuilding, steel, and finance for B2B uniforms, and sports fans and teams for sports merchandise. The student uniform market targets middle and high schools primarily, with growing demand from private elementary schools. The B2B segment serves large corporations and service industries, while the sports segment caters to professional sports teams, esports organizations, and their fan bases.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within South Korea, with domestic sales covering all regions through direct sales and branch-managed dealerships. It also has overseas production facilities in Indonesia for uniform manufacturing. The sports merchandising business includes partnerships with domestic professional sports teams and global expansion through licensing agreements, such as with FC Barcelona for the Korean market.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hyungji Elite functions primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It designs, plans, and outsources production to sewing contractors domestically and overseas, then manages distribution through its own sales network and dealerships. It also handles licensing and retail of sports merchandise, positioning itself as both a manufacturer and distributor.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on continuous product development emphasizing functional, aesthetic, and eco-friendly materials, including recycled fabrics. It maintains a dedicated research institute for student uniform innovation and collaborates with designers for fashion-forward products. Strategic priorities include expanding the sports merchandising business, enhancing brand identity, and pursuing ESG initiatives such as sustainable material sourcing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of finished products in the student uniform, B2B uniform, and sports merchandising segments. The company operates on a wholesale model with dealerships for student uniforms and direct contracts for B2B clients. Sports merchandise sales occur via stadium shops, online platforms, and external retail channels. Licensing fees and royalties are also part of the sports merchandising revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the student uniform market, the company competes with major brands like Ivy Club, Smart, and School Lux, collectively holding about 75% market share. In B2B uniforms, it competes with smaller specialized firms but holds a strong position due to its production infrastructure and client base. In sports merchandising, competitors include smaller specialized firms and listed companies like Interpark. Hyungji Elite leverages its fashion and distribution expertise to maintain a competitive edge and drive market innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 132.7 billion KRW for the fiscal year ending June 2024, representing a 40.5% increase year-over-year. Operating profit rose by 182% to 7 billion KRW, and net income increased by 219% to 6.4 billion KRW. Total assets grew by 14.4% to 143.2 billion KRW, reflecting business expansion. The company has shown strong growth, particularly in the sports merchandising segment, which more than doubled its sales.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hyungji Elite emphasizes its long-standing brand heritage as Korea's leading student uniform brand with over 50 years of experience. It differentiates through customized, high-quality, functional uniforms tailored to individual school needs, supported by a robust production and supply system. The company also integrates sustainability by using recycled materials and offers innovative sports merchandise that blends fashion with fandom culture, enhancing customer engagement and loyalty.
